title: tag
body:
## tag

Names an inclusive range of existing frames and records its playback direction as an Aseprite animation tag. Tags change no pixels; they are saved in sprite.aseprite and listed in sheet.json so that a game engine or an artist in Aseprite can play that sequence. Choose it to label animations such as walk or blink when the sprite has several frames.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Add the tag after the frame nodes it covers: toFrame may not exceed the number of frames created so far.
- Schemaxis's FFmpeg sheet encoding keeps tags as metadata only; they do not select or reorder video playback. It must take its sprite input from the immediately preceding node.

Native binding: `Sprite:newTag`. Output kind: `["sprite"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sprite` | one node | yes | `sprite` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Name of the animation tag, 1 to 64 characters, as shown in Aseprite's timeline and listed in sheet.json for engines that select animations by name. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64}` | **required** |
| `fromFrame` | One-based number of the first frame in the tag; the range is inclusive and fromFrame must not exceed toFrame. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":32}` | **required** |
| `toFrame` | One-based number of the last frame in the tag, included in the range. It must be at least fromFrame and no greater than the number of frames created before this tag node. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":32}` | **required** |
| `direction` | Playback direction stored with the tag (Aseprite's Animation Direction): forward plays fromFrame to toFrame; reverse plays toFrame back to fromFrame; pingPong plays forward then backward and repeats; pingPongReverse is ping-pong that starts with the backward pass. It is metadata for players such as Aseprite or a game engine; Schemaxis renders no animation. | `{"type":"enum","values":["forward","reverse","pingPong","pingPongReverse"]}` | `"forward"` |
